notes: Synthetic: authored by hand from the Amazon Bedrock Runtime API model (Converse, ConverseStream, ContentBlock, ReasoningContentBlock, ContentBlockDelta, TokenUsage, StopReason; read from the AWS Smithy model github.com/aws/api-models-aws bedrock-runtime 2023-09-30 and aws-sdk-go-v2 service/bedrockruntime v1.63.8, the source of the published API reference, since docs.aws.amazon.com was not reachable from the authoring session) and the AWS event-stream framing (prelude, string headers :event-type / :content-type / :message-type, payload, CRC32), and platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-on-amazon-bedrock-legacy (Claude Sonnet 4.6 is served through InvokeModel and Converse under this ARN-versioned ID; global. is its cross-region inference profile, which routes the gateway to Converse), read 2026-10-28. Field names, event types and stop reasons are the documented ones; ids, signatures, token counts and text are invented. Replace each case with a recorded capture (source: recorded) when the live recorder runs. Reasoning cases carry reasoning_effort in request.json because a client would send it, but the gateway forwards nothing that enables reasoning on Bedrock (no additionalModelRequestFields; see upstream_request.golden.json), so they pin what the adapter would do with a reasoning response. The guardrail cases show the default blocked-output message of a guardrail that applies without a guardrailConfig in the request (account-enforced). Usage carries cacheReadInputTokens/cacheWriteInputTokens as Claude responses do; their exact presence when 0 is unverified. Real ConverseStream payloads may carry fields outside the API model (e.g. padding); a recording will show them.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: no canonical field: Bedrock's server-side latency (metrics.latencyMs) has no slot in the OpenAI response

known gap B2: Converse reasoningContent blocks are dropped whole: the reasoning text (reasoning_content), its signature and redactedContent (thinking_blocks). Claude requires reasoning blocks passed back unchanged in a tool-use turn, so a multi-turn tool-use conversation with reasoning cannot be replayed

known gap B8: prompt-cache read tokens (cacheReadInputTokens) are dropped instead of counted in prompt_tokens / prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, so usage and cost under-count cached requests. 0 on the canonical path today, which never sends a cachePoint block
known gap B8: prompt-cache write tokens (cacheWriteInputTokens), billed at a premium, are dropped from usage. 0 on the canonical path today, which never sends a cachePoint block
